_provenance.what: The knowledge_entries rows the merge-base writer stores for both approved GS10 files (pages 26 and 27), before rows carried a release mark, a hold mark or a file hash.
_provenance.how: reprocessNodeDocument at the merge base, run on stub bytes standing in for each file, with the same unpdf page 26/27 text items as gs10-p26-reviewed-rollout.integration.test.ts and NODE_EMBED_ON_WRITE=0. {upload} and {node} stand for the upload and node ids.
